title: Second Builder 50K: EMA + MACD + S/R together, LIT's two_week need size, no-hedge guard vs LIT's account

notes: tools/second_mix.py (PICKS); stored trades = the back-to-back eval path of each span (2021-24, 2025, H1, H2); the run library's own eval columns re-score that path by day and are not the published odds (those are in the verdict).
